name: veo-v3-1-fast
description:
Google's Veo 3.1 Fast is a fast version of Veo 3.1.

Optional parameters:
Set the aspect ratio of the generated image (one of `16:9`, `9:16`).
Silent to generate a silent video at a lower cost.
Set negative prompt option `blur`, `low resolution`, `poor quality`. (only for T2V).
Set the duration `4s`, `6s`, `8s`, default `8s`. `4s` and `6s` are only supported for text-to-video generation

Note: Pass a single image for image to video tasks. Pass two images for a first-frame-to-last-frame video generation task.
